stem: Several containers begin draining much earlier than neighboring containers during the same irrigation event. What should be checked before increasing total irrigation volume?
choices: Reservoir pH, source-water temperature, and tank mixing consistency before checking anything at the emitters
Room humidity, canopy temperature, and airflow uniformity before inspecting the irrigation delivery hardware
Emitter flow and placement, media condition, and whether water is distributing through the intended root zone
Harvest timing, plant spacing, and photoperiod consistency before measuring how water moves through the media
rationale: Early drainage can reflect nonuniform delivery, channeling, media differences, or poor distribution. These should be evaluated before assuming the crop simply needs more total water.
